items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew of two trombone players in Cincinnati. One was a guy named Marcus Ware.

ctx.x: When did you start to lead your own bands in Cincinnati? When did that happen?

In my senior year of high school I organized my own band, a 12-piece band. The unique thing about this band is there were no trombones. I had four trumpets and five saxophones and three rhythm. No trombones, because there just weren’t any trombonists. I knew of two trombone players in Cincinnati. One was a guy named Marcus Ware. Another was a young lady. She played with another band, so I couldn’t get her. She played with a band called the Sons of Rhythm. We had a battle of bands, and they out-swung us. They were…
How did you come by this knowledge? What were you using for your composition?
